value.rationale: The quotient is the complete naturally defined one-generator bilateral meaning algebra of a recently studied hyperintensional logic, with a sharp modal-depth complexity threshold and exact classification of the two exceptional meanings. It provides an intrinsic semantic bound relevant to complete normal-form/translation comparisons, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a mere rebranding of support-level expressive completeness. A multi-letter generalization is neither established nor required for this finite complete classification.
